title: BsgProductAssessment
description: Per-product evaluation against bsg/checklist.yaml. Consumes the existing sources.jsonl and evidence.jsonl produced by the deep-research skill; every item verdict must link to evidence_ids drawn from that store.

product_id.description: Stable slug used as the run directory name (e.g. 'waterfall-bidirectional-security-gateway', 'zoneguard').

product_version_reference.description: Version, release, or datasheet edition the assessment is anchored to. Null if unknown — do NOT invent.

checklist_version.description: Must equal meta.version in checklist.yaml at time of run.

assessment_mode.description: screen = only items with screen:true (quick gate); standard/deep = all items.

overall_notes.description: Optional 1-3 sentence overview. Do NOT restate item verdicts here.

recommendation.description: Final recommendation used downstream. When it differs from default_recommendation the agent MUST fill override_reason (validator enforces).

rationale.description: ≤ 3 sentences citing item IDs and evidence for the chosen recommendation.

default_recommendation.description: Rule-based default computed from item verdicts. If agent fills it, validator checks the value matches its own computation.

override_reason.description: REQUIRED (non-empty) when recommendation != default_recommendation. Explains why the model diverged from the rule.

gate_decision.description: Screen-mode only: required by validator when assessment_mode='screen'. Ignored for standard/deep.

verdict.description: 'unknown' is REQUIRED when no evidence was found; never invent 'not_supported' from absence. 'not_applicable' is for CDS-specific items (e.g. protocol break, CDR, classification filtering) on products that are plain firewalls/routers by category — only when a source establishes that category, not by default.

confidence.description: Capped at 'medium' if source_types contains only 'vendor_doc' (enforced by validator).

numeric_value.description: REQUIRED for items with verdict_type=numeric_threshold when verdict is supported/not_supported. For verdict=partial may be null if notes explain the qualitative/imprecise evidence (e.g. vendor says 'multi-gigabit').

unit.description: Must match the checklist item's threshold.unit when numeric_value is set.

evidence_ids.description: Pointers into evidence.jsonl. MUST be non-empty when verdict != unknown.

cited_source_ids.description: Pointers into sources.jsonl. MUST be non-empty when verdict != unknown.

source_types.description: Distinct source categories represented in cited_source_ids. Used by validator to cap confidence. 'certification_registry' covers NCDSMO / Common Criteria portal / BSI / ANSSI / FIPS validation entries.

notes.description: ≤ 2 sentences, MUST be a paraphrase of cited evidence. No speculation, no comparison to other products.

gaps.description: Optional: what specifically is missing or unclear in the evidence for this item.
